metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'M365 - Suspicious Inbox Rule (Forward / Delete)'

properties.description:
Detects creation or modification of inbox rules that auto-forward to external
recipients, redirect mail, move messages to RSS / Conversation History /
Deleted Items / Junk / Archive, or match attacker-style keywords (invoice,
payment, wire, password, OTP). Classic BEC persistence — attacker creates a
hidden rule that quarantines security notifications from the inbox of a
compromised user.
properties.query:
let sensitive_folders = dynamic(["RSS Feeds","RSS Subscriptions","Conversation History","Deleted Items","Junk Email","Archive"]);
let suspicious_keywords = dynamic(["invoice","payment","wire","bank","password","otp","mfa","security","reset"]);
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules")
// Parameters is a dynamic array of {"Name":..,"Value":..} objects and the
// property names are capitalised. Reading p.name/p.value yields null on every
// row, which silently disables the rule. Regression-tested in tests/test_rules.py.
| mv-expand p = Parameters
| extend PName = tostring(p.Name), PValue = tostring(p.Value)
| extend CleanValue = replace_regex(PValue, @"^\[|\]$|""", "")
| extend TargetEmail = iff(PName in ("ForwardTo","RedirectTo","ForwardAsAttachmentTo"),
                           extract(@"([A-Za-z0-9._%+\-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.\-]+)", 1, CleanValue), "")
| extend UserDomain = tolower(tostring(split(UserId, "@")[1]))
| extend ExternalForward = isnotempty(TargetEmail)
                          and tolower(tostring(split(TargetEmail, "@")[1])) != UserDomain
| where ExternalForward
     or (PName == "MoveToFolder" and CleanValue in (sensitive_folders))
     or (PName == "SubjectContainsWords" and CleanValue has_any (suspicious_keywords))
| extend ParamDetail = strcat(PName, ": ", CleanValue)
// RuleName is only present on rows where the Name parameter was expanded; drop
// the empty strings so the incident shows the actual rule names, not blanks.
| extend RuleNameScalar = iff(PName == "Name", CleanValue, "")
| summarize Params = make_set(ParamDetail), RuleName = make_set_if(RuleNameScalar, isnotempty(RuleNameScalar))
          by TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, ClientIP
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, Operation, RuleName, Params

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{UserId}} performed {{Operation}} from {{ClientIP}} creating a rule that forwards, redirects, or buries mail. Verify with the mailbox owner out of band.
